name: Place and answer calls
plain: Lets the app start or answer phone calls without the user pressing Dial.
meaning: A direct call costs money and can disclose the number; premium-rate fraud is the abuse case. Normal apps should hand off to the dialer instead.

android.store_policy: Play: avoid unless the app is the default dialer; ACTION_DIAL needs nothing
android.note: ACTION_DIAL opens the dialer with the number filled in and needs no permission.

ios.prompt_ui: tel: URL asks the user to confirm Call
ios.note: Apps cannot dial directly; VoIP calls use CallKit and PushKit; no way to answer cellular calls.

limits.headline: Can start calls for you on Android after you allow it; iPhone asks you to confirm
limits.user_action: You tap a phone number, a Call button, or Dial
can: Place a call directly (Android, with permission)
Open the dialer with the number filled in, with no permission
Answer calls on Android 8 and later
Make internet calls through the system calling screen on iPhone
cannot: Answer ordinary phone calls on iPhone
Skip your confirm tap on a phone link on iPhone
limits.differs: Android can dial directly with permission; iPhone always asks you to confirm and cannot answer cellular calls.

story.what_it_is: Lets an app start or answer phone calls without you pressing Dial.
story.for_you: The app asks to make calls. If you say yes, it can dial for you with no extra tap. You pay the cost, so the permission needs trust.
story.for_makers: Click to call is useful for support lines and emergency features. The same power could call a premium number and run up a bill. Most apps instead open the dialer with the number filled in, with no permission.

use_cases.example: A support app dials the helpline in one tap.
A safety app calls an emergency contact when you press a panic button.
A hotel app calls the front desk.
A ride app lets you call the driver.
A food app lets you call the restaurant.
A call assistant dials a number you speak aloud.
A scam app dials a premium number to steal money, which is why it is limited.

story.android_note: Opening the dialer with a number filled in needs no permission.
story.ios_note: iPhone apps cannot dial directly. Internet calls use CallKit and apps cannot answer cellular calls.
